what: Carry the gym code through the Google Play install: the gym invite link's "Get the app" step adds the gym to the Play address, and the app reads it once on first open and offers "Join <gym>" with the code already filled in
why: A person who taps a gym's invite link without the app goes to Play, installs, and then has to find the code again; the link code itself notes the app reads no install referrer, so the gym is lost at the install step
impact_why: Every new member who joins from a gym link passes this step; deferred deep links (Branch, AppsFlyer, Google Play Install Referrer) are the standard way, as known by Jun 2026, not re-checked live
my_view: My view: do it; Google Play passes a "referrer" word to the app for free and nothing personal goes in it, only the 6-letter gym code. Needs a small change in the member app too.

what: Group the member app's "Tell my gym" requests by gym name and city, and show HQ the count ("12 members of Iron Den, Pune asked for MettleUp")
why: Each "Tell my gym" is saved as its own lead with only a gym name typed by a member, so HQ sees many loose rows instead of the strongest sales pitch it has: how many of the gym's own members want it
impact_why: A gym owner told "12 of your members asked for this" is far more likely to say yes than to a cold call
my_view: My view: do it; a simple grouping of the rows already kept (gym name cleaned, plus city), shown on HQ Leads. No new data is collected.

what: Let the demo form keep where the gym came from by a short fixed list of words (instagram, google-ad, poster, gym-page, owner-referral), sent by the landing page from the link it was opened with
why: Today a demo request is either "from a member", "from the member app" or nothing, so HQ cannot tell which ad, poster or the "Get a free page like this one" link on a gym page brought a gym, nor credit an owner who recommended another gym
impact_why: Tells him which marketing money works before he spends more; also needed for the owner-to-owner loop idea IM-L18-panel-ui-shell-05
my_view: My view: do it; only known words are kept (as today), so nothing personal is added. One short list on the server and the page reads it from its link.

what: Each week, list the help questions the AI said its help pages do not cover, and the answers people tapped "No, this did not solve it" on, grouped by topic, so the missing help page gets written
why: The AI already marks an answer as not covered and keeps the "Did this solve it?" tap, but nothing turns those into a to-do; the same unanswered question keeps costing an AI call and a team reply
impact_why: Every new help page answers future questions for free and cuts team replies; Intercom and Zendesk show the same "content gaps" list, as known by Jun 2026, not re-checked live
my_view: My view: do it; a weekly summary in the existing daily report, reading only rows already kept. No member data beyond the question text the team already reads.

what: On a gym's own web page, when the owner's free trial is on, make the main button "Try free for N days" (with "Become a member" next to it)
why: The join page link preview already leads with the free trial, but the gym's web page main button only says "Become a member", so a visitor who would only try first does not see the offer until the next page
impact_why: A free trial is the easiest yes for a stranger; Glofox and Mindbody gym web pages lead with "Book a free trial", as known by Jun 2026, not re-checked live
my_view: My view: do it when the gym web page and the free trial are switched on, not before; the trial days are already read for the join page.

what: When a person verifies their number for joining online, let the WhatsApp "verified" reply also carry the gym's app link ("Get the <gym> app: link")
why: The person is already in a WhatsApp chat with us at the moment they join, and the reply is free in that window, but it only says "go back to the page"
impact_why: Gets new joiners into the member app on day 1; but Meta refuses our replies while the 131042 block lasts, so it only helps once that clears
my_view: My view: wait until Meta lifts the 131042 block on our replies; then it is one line of wording (with your yes on the words).

what: After a gym owner sends the free demo form, answer with a "Chat with us on WhatsApp now" link that opens a chat with MettleUp's number and a ready message ("Hi, I asked for a demo for <gym>")
why: Today the form only answers "sent" and the owner waits for a call; an owner who messages first is a warmer lead, and messages people send to us still arrive while our own sends are blocked
impact_why: Speed to first contact decides most small-business software sales; Indian SaaS landing pages commonly offer a WhatsApp chat button, as known by Jun 2026, not re-checked live
my_view: My view: do it; the server only adds the chat link to its answer and the page shows it. It also works around the blocked outgoing WhatsApp.

what: Within an hour of a new app version, if crash reports with the same error arrive from several phones, send HQ an alert, instead of waiting for the next daily crash run
why: Crash reports are kept at once, but only a daily run turns them into issues, so a bad release can crash members for up to a day before anyone hears
impact_why: Catches a broken release while it is still on few phones; complements the Play crash-rate idea IM-L18-server-ci-workflows-02
my_view: My view: do it after the stage-by-stage release idea; a small hourly check on rows already kept, sending HQ's existing alert. No personal data involved.

what: Let HQ send a bell message to one group of gyms only (gyms on the free trial, or paying gyms), not always to every gym
why: HQ news is the same for every gym, so trial tips ("add your first members") reach paying owners and plan news reaches trial owners
impact_why: Helps the trial-to-paid push with tips at the right time; few gyms today, so small for now
my_view: My view: not now; worth doing once there are 20 or more gyms, when the noise starts to matter.
